title: MR Strategy — FCF Top-200, 10 Most Oversold
description: Mean Reversion backtest results. Universe: top-1500 domestic, FCF>2%, net debt <=1x, vol >=$20M. Stage-1: top-200 by FCF yield. Stage-2: 10 most oversold. Daily rebalance. IS 2001-2021: CAGR +29.6%, IR 0.751, MaxDD -74.8%. OOS 2022-2026: CAGR +14.3%, IR 0.416, MaxDD -34.6%. Second fix this cycle: fcf_ttm/ebit_ttm (ART dimension) were previously reset to NULL whenever a newer filing reported one field but not the other (e.g. STX 2003-11-14: ebit reported, fcf blank), even though the real trailing FCF hadn't changed. Confirmed via Arvind's STX divergence report (STX ranks #195/#181 in their Stage-1 pool on 2003-12-10/2004-01-21 with fcf_yield_ttm ~4.9-5.4%, but was absent from our disclosed holdings until 2004-04-23 due to this false fcf_yield=NULL exclusion). Fixed with an independent forward-fill for fcf_ttm and ebit_ttm, capped at 100 days since the field was last reported (bridges one missed quarter; falls back to NULL rather than a stale multi-quarter-old number beyond that). Broader impact than the prior net_debt_to_mcap fix -- affects both IS and OOS.

title: MR Stage-1 (FCF-yield) Pool — Full Eligible List, 2003-12-10
description: Every ticker that clears our MR Mani-spec screens (domestic rank<=1500, DV>=$20M(+7%/yr) via combined dual-class volume, mcap>=$500M(+7%/yr), revenue>=$50M(+7%/yr), net debt<=1x, FCF yield>=2%, price>=$2) on 2026-07-05's MR reconciliation investigation date 2003-12-10, ranked by fcf_yield_ttm descending (361 names). STX ranks #195 here (comfortably inside our top-200 Stage-1 cutoff) and is the #1 most-oversold Stage-2 pick that day (signal_70d_return -27.0%) -- yet Mani's own disclosed CSV shows no STX holding at all until 2004-04-23. Shared so Mani's Claude can check its own eligible list against ours on this exact date and help pin down the divergence.

title: MOM Strategy — Top-500 Domestic, FCF>0%
description: Momentum (6m1m) backtest results. Universe: top-500 domestic stocks by market cap, positive FCF. Weekly Friday rebalance (drift-hold between rebals), N=10. IS 2001-2021: CAGR +15.1%, IR 0.547, MaxDD -60.0%. OOS 2022-2026: CAGR +41.6%, IR 1.065, MaxDD -40.8%. Fixed: holiday Fridays (e.g. Good Friday) now correctly snap the rebalance back to Thursday instead of silently skipping that week's rebalance entirely.
